name: Toukai Kitou
source:
A romance visual novel.

In a town where youkai are very frequent, a recently arrived girl with oni blood usually wanders at the time of twilight exterminating mononoke. Also realizing that job are a mysterious man with tengu skills and a very talented miko, classmate of hers.
